mapper.select:
select 'CORE' as sourceSYS, (select fc.ws_com_code from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id = gh.company_id) as companyNumber,
gh.je_date as bizDate,
gh.je_creation_date as bookedDate,
substr(gh.period_name, 1, instr(gh.period_name, '-') - 1) as periodYear,
substr(gh.period_name, instr(gh.period_name, '-', -1) + 1) as periodNumber,
case when gl.je_trx = 'PRE_FIN_INCOME_RECOGNITION' THEN '预' ELSE '业' end voucherType,
'0' as attaches, '' as description, gh.je_number as voucherNumber,
(@i :=@i + 1) AS entrySeq,
gl.je_description as voucherAbstract,
gl.cost_center_id as profitCenterNumber,
(select ga.account_code from gld_account ga where ga.account_id = gl.account_id) accountNumber,
(select fc.eas_code from fnd_currency fc where fc.currency_code = gh.currency) currencyNumber,
nvl(gl.exchange_rate, 1) as localRate,
case when gl.dr_cr = 'DR' then '1' else '-1' end entryDC,
nvl(gl.dr_amount, 0) + nvl(gl.cr_amount, 0) as originalAmount,
'0' as qty,
'' as measurement,
'0' as price,
nvl(gl.dr_functional_amount, 0) as debitAmount,
nvl(gl.cr_functional_amount, 0) as creditAmount,
(select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = gh.trialed_by) as creator,
(select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = gh.retrialed_by) as auditor,
'' as poster,
(@ii :=@ii + 1) AS asstSeq,
(select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'GLD.JE_SEGMENT_TYPE' and v.code_value = ga.assist_type1) as asstActType1,
case when ga.assist_type1 = 'BP_NAME' THEN (select cc.eas_bp_code from con_contract cc where cc.eas_bp_name = gl.segment_1 and rownum=1)
when ga.assist_type1 = 'VENDER_NAME' THEN nvl((select lnn.eas_code from csh_payment_req_ln lnn where lnn.bp_bank_account_name = gl.segment_1 and lnn.eas_code is not null and rownum=1), (select h.eas_bp_code from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_name = gl.segment_1 and h.eas_bp_code is not null and rownum=1)) when ga.assist_type1 = 'CONTRACT_NUMBER' then (select cc.eas_code from con_contract cc where cc.contract_number = gl.segment_1 and cc.eas_code is not null and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type1 = 'UNIT_ID' then (select nvl(fou.eas_code, 'HX' || fou.unit_id) from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_name = gl.segment_1 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type1 = 'CITY' then (select ecd.city_code from eas_city_data ecd where ecd.city_n = gl.segment_1 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type1 = 'BANK_NAME' then (select cba.ref_v04 from csh_bank_account cba, csh_bank cb where cb.bank_id = cba.bank_id and cba.bank_branch_name = gl.segment_1 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type1 = 'BANK_ACCOUNT' then (select nvl(cba.ref_v05, 'HX' || cba.bank_account_id) from csh_bank_account cba where cba.bank_account_num = gl.segment_1 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type1 = 'CF_TYPE' then '01.14' when ga.assist_type1 = 'TAX_STUCTURE' then '0001' when ga.assist_type1 = 'LEASE_ITEM_CATEGORY' then (select t.eas_code from hls_business_type t where t.description = gl.segment_1 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type1 = 'JOINT' then nvl((select fc.ws_com_code from fnd_company fc where fc.fin_company_name = gl.segment_1 and rownum=1), (select h.bp_code from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_name = gl.segment_1 and rownum=1)) ELSE NULL end asstActNumber1,
case when ga.assist_type1 = 'CF_TYPE' then '风险金' when ga.assist_type1 = 'TAX_STUCTURE' then '17%动产经营租赁' ELSE gl.segment_1 end asstActName1,
(select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'GLD.JE_SEGMENT_TYPE' and v.code_value = ga.assist_type2) as asstActType2,
case when ga.assist_type2 = 'BP_NAME' THEN (select cc.eas_bp_code from con_contract cc where cc.eas_bp_name = gl.segment_2 and cc.eas_bp_code is not null and rownum=1)
when ga.assist_type2 = 'VENDER_NAME' THEN nvl((select lnn.eas_code from csh_payment_req_ln lnn where lnn.bp_bank_account_name = gl.segment_2 and lnn.eas_code is not null and rownum=1), (select h.eas_bp_code from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_name = gl.segment_2 and h.eas_bp_code is not null and rownum=1)) when ga.assist_type2 = 'CONTRACT_NUMBER' then (select cc.eas_code from con_contract cc where cc.contract_number = gl.segment_2 and cc.eas_code is not null and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type2 = 'UNIT_ID' then (select nvl(fou.eas_code, 'HX' || fou.unit_id) from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_name = gl.segment_2 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type2 = 'CITY' then (select ecd.city_code from eas_city_data ecd where ecd.city_n = gl.segment_2 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type2 = 'BANK_NAME' then (select cba.ref_v04 from csh_bank_account cba, csh_bank cb where cb.bank_id = cba.bank_id and cba.bank_branch_name = gl.segment_2 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type2 = 'BANK_ACCOUNT' then (select nvl(cba.ref_v05, 'HX' || cba.bank_account_id) from csh_bank_account cba where cba.bank_account_num = gl.segment_2 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type2 = 'CF_TYPE' then '01.14' when ga.assist_type2 = 'TAX_STUCTURE' then '0001' when ga.assist_type2 = 'LEASE_ITEM_CATEGORY' then (select t.eas_code from hls_business_type t where t.description = gl.segment_2 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type1 = 'JOINT' then nvl((select fc.ws_com_code from fnd_company fc where fc.fin_company_name = gl.segment_2 and rownum=1), (select h.bp_code from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_name = gl.segment_1 and rownum=1)) ELSE NULL end asstActNumber2,
case when ga.assist_type2 = 'CF_TYPE' then '风险金' when ga.assist_type2 = 'TAX_STUCTURE' then '17%动产经营租赁'
ELSE gl.segment_2 end asstActName2,
(select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'GLD.JE_SEGMENT_TYPE' and v.code_value = ga.assist_type3) as asstActType3,
case when ga.assist_type3 = 'BP_NAME' THEN (select cc.eas_bp_code from con_contract cc where cc.eas_bp_name = gl.segment_3 and cc.eas_bp_code is not null and rownum=1)
when ga.assist_type3 = 'VENDER_NAME' THEN nvl((select lnn.eas_code from csh_payment_req_ln lnn where lnn.bp_bank_account_name = gl.segment_3 and lnn.eas_code is not null and rownum=1), (select h.eas_bp_code from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_name = gl.segment_3 and h.eas_bp_code is not null and rownum=1)) when ga.assist_type3 = 'CONTRACT_NUMBER' then (select cc.eas_code from con_contract cc where cc.contract_number = gl.segment_3 and cc.eas_code is not null and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type3 = 'UNIT_ID' then (select nvl(fou.eas_code, 'HX' || fou.unit_id) from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_name = gl.segment_3 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type3 = 'CITY' then (select ecd.city_code from eas_city_data ecd where ecd.city_n = gl.segment_3 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type3 = 'BANK_NAME' then (select cba.ref_v04 from csh_bank_account cba, csh_bank cb where cb.bank_id = cba.bank_id and cba.bank_branch_name = gl.segment_3 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type3 = 'BANK_ACCOUNT' then (select nvl(cba.ref_v05, 'HX' || cba.bank_account_id) from csh_bank_account cba where cba.bank_account_num = gl.segment_3 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type3 = 'CF_TYPE' then '01.14' when ga.assist_type3 = 'TAX_STUCTURE' then '0001' when ga.assist_type3 = 'LEASE_ITEM_CATEGORY' then (select t.eas_code from hls_business_type t where t.description = gl.segment_3 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type1 = 'JOINT' then nvl((select fc.ws_com_code from fnd_company fc where fc.fin_company_name = gl.segment_3 and rownum=1), (select h.bp_code from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_name = gl.segment_3 and rownum=1)) ELSE NULL end asstActNumber3,
case when ga.assist_type3 = 'CF_TYPE' then '风险金' when ga.assist_type3 = 'TAX_STUCTURE' then '17%动产经营租赁' ELSE gl.segment_3 end asstActName3,
(select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'GLD.JE_SEGMENT_TYPE' and v.code_value = ga.assist_type4) as asstActType4,
case when ga.assist_type4 = 'BP_NAME' THEN (select cc.eas_bp_code from con_contract cc where cc.eas_bp_name = gl.segment_4 and cc.eas_bp_code is not null and rownum=1)
when ga.assist_type4 = 'VENDER_NAME' THEN nvl((select lnn.eas_code from csh_payment_req_ln lnn where lnn.bp_bank_account_name = gl.segment_4 and lnn.eas_code is not null and rownum=1), (select h.eas_bp_code from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_name = gl.segment_4 and h.eas_bp_code is not null and rownum=1)) when ga.assist_type4 = 'CONTRACT_NUMBER' then (select cc.eas_code from con_contract cc where cc.contract_number = gl.segment_4 and cc.eas_code is not null and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type4 = 'UNIT_ID' then (select nvl(fou.eas_code, 'HX' || fou.unit_id) from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_name = gl.segment_4 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type4 = 'CITY' then (select ecd.city_code from eas_city_data ecd where ecd.city_n = gl.segment_4 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type4 = 'BANK_NAME' then (select cba.ref_v04 from csh_bank_account cba, csh_bank cb where cb.bank_id = cba.bank_id and cba.bank_branch_name = gl.segment_4 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type4 = 'BANK_ACCOUNT' then (select nvl(cba.ref_v05, 'HX' || cba.bank_account_id) from csh_bank_account cba where cba.bank_account_num = gl.segment_4 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type4 = 'CF_TYPE' then '01.14' when ga.assist_type4 = 'TAX_STUCTURE' then '0001' when ga.assist_type4 = 'LEASE_ITEM_CATEGORY' then (select t.eas_code from hls_business_type t where t.description = gl.segment_4 and rownum=1) when ga.assist_type1 = 'JOINT' then nvl((select fc.ws_com_code from fnd_company fc where fc.fin_company_name = gl.segment_4 and rownum=1), (select h.bp_code from hls_bp_master h where h.bp_name = gl.segment_4 and rownum=1)) ELSE NULL end asstActNumber4,
case when ga.assist_type4 = 'CF_TYPE' then '风险金' when ga.assist_type4 = 'TAX_STUCTURE' then '17%动产经营租赁' ELSE gl.segment_4 end asstActName4,
'' as asstActType5,
'' as asstActNumber5,
'' as asstActName5,
'' as asstActType6,
'' as asstActNumber6,
'' as asstActName6,
'' as asstActType7,
'' as asstActNumber7,
'' as asstActName7,
'' as asstActType8,
'' as asstActNumber8,
'' as asstActName8 from gld_je_head gh, gld_je_line gl, gld_account ga,(SELECT @i := 0) AS row_seq,(SELECT @ii := 0) AS row_seq1 where gh.je_head_id = gl.je_head_id and gl.account_id = ga.account_id and gh.je_head_id = #{sourceId}
